name: currency-wallet
title: Currency wallet
description: A multi-currency wallet in Tiles: a currency switch, a rewards panel that names the next tier, a spending donut and allocation bars.

props.name: data
props.description: One entry per currency, each with its balance, rewards, spending and allocation.

props.name: defaultCurrency
props.description: The currency code selected first. Default the first entry in `data`.

props.name: note
props.description: Footer text on the balance tile. Default "Example data."

props.name: now
props.description: Not read yet; the screen does not depend on the date.

props.name: labels
props.type: { currency?: string; balance?: string; rewards?: string; spending?: string; allocation?: string; points?: string; toNext?: (n: number, tier: string) => string }
props.description: Visible text and screen reader text, with English defaults.

a11y.text: An h1, tiles named by their h2, and a currency switch, Pills from chart-kit (default label "Currency"); every tile follows the chosen currency. The rewards progress bar is aria-hidden because the "to next" sentence says the same; allocation bars are aria-hidden and the share is written as text. The donut is described in its own note.
Pills arrows switch currency, with Home and End.
The bar transitions are dropped under reduced motion.
